notice: 157 exact original declaration records are not 157 runtime tests. Native ABI aliases, declarations, private observer fields, sentinels and deleted special members remain support facilities. Managed consumers use records, retained typed arrays, checked resource handles or ID snapshots. Native varargs and pointer syntax remain native; application logs use checked scalar formatting. Each support group and consuming API requires separate execution evidence.

rulings.containers: No standalone JS STL/container library. Span borrows upstream storage; managed mesh views retain native owners and resize snapshots. StableVector indices may reuse erased slots; managed texture handles apply their native validity checks.
rulings.observers: Observer control blocks and pool lifetime remain native. Copy and move track the same observed object; copied observed objects keep independent blocks. Expired managed handles reject dereference.
rulings.property_sets: Native bitset algebra and iterator operations remain native. Registered property sets are ordered detached PropertyId[] snapshots; operators have no separate JS syntax.
rulings.log_sentinel: LT_MAX is a native count sentinel, not a legal managed severity. LogType retains the six legal values; both log routes reject 6.
rulings.debug: Assert routes through the selected native log sink. Assertion macros, native debugger breaks and Tracy remain build facilities.
rulings.traits: Native deleted special members enforce ownership; type-name and family templates remain native ABI support. Scriptable class identity uses checked opaque tokens and concrete wrappers.
